findings.description: The `request` parameter was renamed from `attempts` to `max_attempts`, and `add_comment` was updated, but `create_ticket` still passes `attempts=1`. It is no longer recognised and falls into `**fields`, so `attempts: 1` is sent in the JSON body to the vendor API (it may be rejected or ignored). `max_attempts` stays at the default of 3, so the non-idempotent POST is retried on transport errors and 5xx responses. A retry after a timeout can create duplicate tickets, which `attempts=1` was meant to prevent.
findings.suggestion: Change `attempts=1` to `max_attempts=1` in the create_ticket call.
